literal_source_claim: A system cannot prove its own consistency.
domain_and_universes: Open: an immutable source must specify the recursively axiomatized formal theory, its arithmetic interpretation and strength, its proof predicate and coding, and the metatheory in which consistency and unprovability are asserted.
conclusion: Open: the gloss does not distinguish an external assertion T does not prove Con(T), an internal implication Con(T) -> not Prov_T(Con(T)), or a schema over eligible theories.
excluded_degenerate_cases: Not yet frozen. Inconsistent, non-effective, too-weak, nonclassical, and nonstandard provability presentations cannot be included or excluded without the exact source theorem.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; classical logic, arithmetic theory, metatheory, and consistency-strength policy are not frozen because the proposition is underspecified
tcb_profile: Lean kernel 4.29.0 and pinned mathlib are the intended base; any syntax/proof-system implementation, import closure, and external formalization remain open
computation_profile: No computation, oracle, experiment, or unchecked certificate is credited; effective syntax and proof checking will be root-critical once selected
formal_system: Lean 4 + mathlib under the rev-5.6 adapter
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source selection, system or provability-predicate choice, canonical wording, Lean target, toolchain, mathlib pin, assurance profile, or validator change; review due date and independent reviewers remain open.
status_boundary: Self-tested planned intake only. Pinned Lean first-order syntax and encoding APIs elaborate, but the repository gloss does not determine a unique second-incompleteness proposition. No H0, M0, R0, accepted proof state, audit completion, or theorem completion is claimed.
